input.descriptionText:
Kestrel is building the next generation of logistics software from our Amsterdam canal-side office.

Visa sponsorship is available for this role, and we offer a relocation package to help you move to the Netherlands.

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience with Java and Spring Boot
- Experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ
